name: Tobijah
overview: Tobijah is mentioned in Scripture as a Levite who was sent by King Jehoshaphat along with other Levites and priests to instruct the people in the law, highlighting the importance of faithful teaching and adherence to God's Word (2 Chronicles 17:8). Additionally, Tobijah is identified as one of the captives who returned from Babylonian exile, signifying God's preservation of His people through captivity (Zechariah 6:10). Finally, Tobijah is honored with a crown in a memorial within the temple of the LORD, symbolizing a recognition of faithful service and God's enduring covenant with His people (Zechariah 6:14).
